entries.summary: Talent range modifiers, and fixes for integer item stats and inherited rewires
highlights: New talent range modifiers: grow an ability's melee reach, shot range, area radius or rectangle in the editor's Make an ability bigger
An ability's area hits grow with its radius, Snow Queen's skating hitbox included, from their own vanilla size
Integer stats such as Extra MO Choice, Extra skill choice and Rooted are written as whole numbers, so items and talents giving them work
A range talent refuses a range its ability lacks instead of scaling another ability's
Rework talents refuse an ambiguous rewire into an inherited file instead of wiring the wrong node

entries.summary: Item effect fixes: Vitality and Attack power entered in displayed points, correct card units for flat stats, per-level shield scaling
highlights: Vitality and Attack power effects are entered as the number shown in game (10 = +10%), no more x100 bonuses
Armour, Shield and other flat stats show their real number on item cards instead of x100
New per_level = true: item effects can grow with hero level, like Fairy Dust's shield
Fractional Free Reroll amounts are rejected instead of silently rounding to 0

entries.summary: Pams fixes
highlights: Pams fixes

entries.summary: In-game Mods menu support: mods switched on or off in Settings > Mods are carried into your library on the next launch, and the pause menu gets a Mods button. Integer item stats (free rerolls, charges) now show their real number on the card instead of +0.
highlights: In-game Mods menu support: mods switched on or off in Settings > Mods are carried into your library on the next launch, and the pause menu gets a Mods button. Integer item stats (free rerolls, charges) now show their real number on the card instead of +0.

entries.summary: In-game Mods menu: a Mods tab in the game's own Settings page (switch mods on or off for the next launch, change mod settings while you play) and a Mods button in the pause menu. Replaces the old drawn overlay.
highlights: In-game Mods menu: a Mods tab in the game's own Settings page (switch mods on or off for the next launch, change mod settings while you play) and a Mods button in the pause menu. Replaces the old drawn overlay.

entries.summary: Custom item effects now stack with duplicate copies: holding a second copy raises the stat and the card number (always-on and timed effects; super effects unchanged).
highlights: Custom item effects now stack with duplicate copies: holding a second copy raises the stat and the card number (always-on and timed effects; super effects unchanged).

entries.summary: In-game mod menu: an ImGui panel drawn on the game's DX12 swapchain, painted onto the book. Adds R.debug.components.
highlights: In-game mod menu: an ImGui panel drawn on the game's DX12 swapchain, painted onto the book. Adds R.debug.components.

entries.summary: Supper Effect on Items and Always on Night/Day
highlights: Supper Effect on Items and Always on Night/Day

entries.summary: Talents can give a TRAIT charge
highlights: Talents can give +1 TRAIT charge, the same way Merlin's quest and Snow Queen's Trait Charge do (TRAIT charges were refused before)

entries.summary: Talents built from scratch reliably, game-event triggers, and a simpler talent editor
highlights: Talent changes no longer copy parts from other heroes: every part is written, so talent mods are more reliable across game updates
Talent bonuses can start from game events: taking damage, your ultimate, day or night, picking a talent or item, dream shards, Sandman purchases, rerolls
Every option the talent editor offers now builds, for every hero (several failed before, e.g. on Kintaro and Snow Queen)
The talent editor has one place to change what a talent does: the builder, which can add to a talent or replace it
Charges that the game never grants (TRAIT charges) are refused, and charges show as whole numbers

entries.summary: Items from scratch, safer item bans, and a warning for item stats the game never reads
highlights: Item bans no longer wipe the save progress of banned items: apply and restore put back what the game dropped
You can ban every item: empty vendor pools get a harmless Sold Out item instead of crashing the game
Make magical objects from scratch: list always-on and after-a-trigger bonuses, no base item needed
The item editor gets Start from scratch, an effects list and ids of any length
Lint warns when an item's effect changes a stat the game never reads

entries.summary: Editor: card text no longer garbled in a local clone; clearer tabs, custom item flow and talent builder
highlights: Item and talent card text is readable again in the local editor (a font table and page from different game builds were paired)
Tabs say what each editor does, and a short tour opens on first launch
"+ New custom item" starts a new item from a copy of a shipped one
Talent builder blocks are named, say what they do in plain words, and show each rarity's number as the card shows it

entries.summary: Discord Url Update
highlights: Discord Link Update

entries.summary: Item mods: timed effects on any item, build checks, and a real card preview in the editor.
highlights: New item field effect = { stat, amount, seconds, on }: a timed bonus on a trigger (taking damage, dash, special, defense, power, talent picked, item picked up, dream shards, night, and more), with the item icon counting it down
Copied items get their own identity by default, so picking up another item no longer takes one away
rsmm lint and the build warn about item traps: bonuses that stack forever, hidden level scaling, a card that reads +0%
The item editor gets a Timed effect section and a card preview that shows the numbers the game will print

entries.summary: Item mods: timed bonuses and correct cards. Copied items show their own description, can drop the super effect, show fractions as percentages, and can copy parts from other items.
highlights: Items can copy parts from another item with clone steps (from = an entity path), e.g. a timed '+X for N seconds' bonus
New percent step shows a card number as a percentage (a 0.3 crit bonus read '+0%')
super_effect = false removes a copy's super effect and its card text
A copy now shows its own description even when its base's text key does not contain the base id
The item editor gets an own-identity checkbox for copies, so a copy is not granted as its base

entries.summary: Item mods can fix behaviour, not just numbers: new [[content.steps]] graph edits on a copied item. The editor now opens and saves items that use them.
highlights: Item mods take [[content.steps]] (set / link / add_link / remove_link) to rewire a copied item, e.g. turn a permanent on-hit bonus into a timed one
The item editor opens and saves items with steps instead of refusing them
Fixed link labels written into entities whose shipped references are stale

entries.summary: Item copies can change rarity, the book fits added items, and the map editor edits scenery.
highlights: A copied item now really takes the rarity you pick in the editor or manifest; before, it kept its base item's tier in game.
The book's Objects tab widens each tier's grid when mods add items, so new items no longer spill over the next row.
Map editor: move, remove and add a chapter's own scenery objects, plus a 3D tile mode.
The editors answer faster: newest request first, and game data is kept between visits.

entries.summary: Chapter editor, CLI updates without an app release, and a restore fix that protects game files
highlights: The map editor is now a chapter editor: add, move and remove spots, pin tiles, and paint terrain shape, surface and tint
The CLI now updates on its own between app releases; Settings > Updates and the version footer show which CLI build is running
Fixed: after a game update, restoring could delete the game's hero files and leave only Random on hero select
Fixed: the Update 5 backport's hero table was undone on the next apply

entries.summary: Restore no longer deletes game files when the asset map is from an older game build; the values backport now stays applied
highlights: Fixed: after a game update, restoring could delete the game's hero files and leave only Random on hero select. The asset map is now rebuilt before apply and restore.
Fixed: the Update 5 backport's hero table was undone on the next apply, so the old values never reached the game.

entries.summary: The app opens links, feels faster, and can get CLI fixes without a new release.
highlights: Links in the app (Discord, Ko-fi, GitHub, docs) open in your browser again.
Screens load much faster: the CLI stays warm between calls instead of restarting each time.
Linux AppImage: built on a newer base, so it no longer runs sluggishly. It needs glibc 2.39 (Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 13, Fedora 40 or newer); older systems should use the .deb.
CLI fixes can now arrive between app releases; Settings, About shows which CLI build is running.
Release notes for loader updates show a proper heading.

entries.summary: First CLI channel build: Python fixes now reach the app without an app release; read-only commands answer from one warm process
highlights: First CLI channel build: Python fixes now reach the app without an app release; read-only commands answer from one warm process

entries.summary: The damage meter now names your teammates exactly, by the hero each of them plays.
highlights: Damage meter: teammates are matched to their row by the hero they picked in the lobby, so their names no longer carry a '?'.
Damage meter: crits and blocked damage are counted, and damage taken matches the game's own total.
Damage meter: the per-ability split works again after Update 6.
Overlays hide a column no row has data for, so mods can add optional columns behind a setting.

entries.summary: Mods can offer settings for their game-data edits: sliders and switches in a mod's config now drive its numbers.
highlights: Mod authors: entity edits can take a value from the mod's config (`config`, `times`) and be switched on or off (`when`).
Mod authors: [[patch]] stat values can come from config too, e.g. a camp size slider.
Changing such a setting rebuilds the mod's files on the next launch.

entries.summary: Mod pages in your language, Update 6 fixes for hero picks, and a new challenge content kind.
highlights: Browse and mod pages show a mod's own translation (name, summary, description) when the app runs in that language.
Hero ids fixed for Update 6; picking a hero someone else took is handled more safely.
New 'challenge' content kind (experimental) for editing the run challenges.
Lint warns when a mod edits a hero part that Update 6 replaced, so the edit would do nothing.
A small, dismissible Ko-fi note on the Library after a few modded launches.

entries.summary: Update 6 symbols, taken-hero pick, va-gate hash
highlights: Update 6 symbols, taken-hero pick, va-gate hash

entries.summary: Finds the game when Steam is installed outside Program Files, and the Game folder setting now actually applies (#55).
highlights: Game folder setting in Settings is now used by every command; before, it was saved but ignored (#55).
Steam installed anywhere (not just Program Files) is found automatically through the Windows registry.

entries.summary: R.modifier.allow_unlocks: opt-in, keeps achievement/outfit/difficulty tracking on during runs with modifiers (#54). Adds R.debug.observe. Needs the updated pattern DB for GameModifierLock_OnStateChange.
highlights: R.modifier.allow_unlocks: opt-in, keeps achievement/outfit/difficulty tracking on during runs with modifiers (#54). Adds R.debug.observe. Needs the updated pattern DB for GameModifierLock_OnStateChange.

entries.summary: update-loader
highlights: update-loader

entries.summary: Ravenswatch Update 6 compatibility: fixes the damage meter naming you as another player, talent grants/upgrades, rerolls, dream shards, ingredients, melodies, game options and XP reading the wrong memory after the patch.
highlights: Damage meter shows your own damage under your name again (Update 6 moved the hero data)
Hero detection works again: health and HUD reads fixed for Update 6
Talent grants, upgrades and random ultimates read the right talent slots again
Rerolls, dream shards, ingredients, melodies and stat modifiers use the correct engine events again
Game options (R.options) read and write the right settings again
SDK engine addresses now update with every game patch instead of going stale

entries.summary: Mod Manager updated for Ravenswatch Update 6: installing mods and the loader works with the patched game again.
highlights: Hero, talent and item mods build against the renamed Update 6 hero files
Installing the loader now replaces a pattern database left over from before the patch, so features like player names in the damage meter work again
New `rsmm values backport` command: play an older patch's balance values as a local mod

entries.summary: Updated for Ravenswatch Update 6: the loader finds the game's functions again after the patch, and mods that change heroes, talents or items work with the new hero files.
highlights: Works with Ravenswatch Update 6 (the 12 October 2026 patch)
Hero, talent and item mods work with the renamed Update 6 hero files
Kintaro shows up as a hero

entries.summary: RSMM has a new logo.
highlights: New app icon and logo: a red gear with a feather, across the app, the website and the docs.

entries.summary: The Overlay button no longer stays greyed out after you install a mod.
highlights: Fixed: after installing a mod with an overlay, its Overlay button could stay greyed out for minutes. The app now refreshes overlays right after an install, an apply or a settings change.
An overlay whose settings file is missing now still opens; only its controls are hidden, and hovering the button explains why.

entries.summary: Adds game-language-aware mod translations and cached game-value reads. Fixes launch-option handling so enabling or restoring the loader preserves the player's existing Steam options.
highlights: Adds game-language-aware mod translations and cached game-value reads. Fixes launch-option handling so enabling or restoring the loader preserves the player's existing Steam options.

entries.summary: Cleaner overlays you can always reset, working option dropdowns, mods in your language, and your own Steam launch options are left alone.
highlights: Overlays: column headers, columns that line up, buttons that appear only on hover, and a window that fits the board exactly (no more grey box below it on Linux).
Overlays can no longer get stuck full-screen: a reset button and a command-palette entry put one back at its normal size, and a once-maximized overlay heals itself on reopen.
Option dropdowns in mod settings and overlays work again. Many mods listed their choices in a way the app did not read, so the menu was empty.
Mods can ship translations: with the app in Chinese, a translated mod shows its name, overlay and settings in Chinese.
Restoring the game and launching it from the app now keep your own Steam launch options (for example NVIDIA settings) instead of replacing them.

entries.summary: Cleaner overlays you can always reset, working option dropdowns, mods in your language, and your own Steam launch options are left alone.
highlights: Overlays: column headers, columns that line up, buttons that appear only on hover, and a window that fits the board exactly (no more grey box below it on Linux).
Overlays can no longer get stuck full-screen: a reset button and a command-palette entry put one back at its normal size, and a once-maximized overlay heals itself on reopen.
Option dropdowns in mod settings and overlays work again. Many mods listed their choices in a way the app did not read, so the menu was empty.
Mods can ship translations: with the app in Chinese, a translated mod shows its name, overlay and settings in Chinese.
Restoring the game and launching it from the app now keep your own Steam launch options (for example NVIDIA settings) instead of replacing them.

entries.summary: The Damage Meter no longer counts as a gameplay mod online, and mod authors get the full list of run events.
highlights: Online: the Damage Meter is now treated as a client-only mod again, so running it no longer marks you as modded for public matchmaking.
Mod authors: 26 run events (hero death, chests, shop purchases, item and talent picks, chapter-end stats and more) are now listed with their fields in rsmm symbols events, and rsmm lint accepts them.
Mod authors: R.status.watch_stagger() and R.status.stagger() read stagger values, and the Lua API docs record which calls are proven in game.

entries.summary: Lua SDK: run-event catalog updated — 32 analytics events with their fields (hero_death, open_chest, sandman_buy, item/talent picks, chapter_end stats, ...); level_up_reach corrected to levelup_run
highlights: Lua SDK: run-event catalog updated — 32 analytics events with their fields (hero_death, open_chest, sandman_buy, item/talent picks, chapter_end stats, ...); level_up_reach corrected to levelup_run

entries.summary: Lua SDK: R.status.watch_stagger()/stagger() read the hero's stagger values; R.melody.choose documented as not working (melodies are random); R.revive, R.status.clear and R.run.lose marked proven
highlights: Lua SDK: R.status.watch_stagger()/stagger() read the hero's stagger values; R.melody.choose documented as not working (melodies are random); R.revive, R.status.clear and R.run.lose marked proven

entries.summary: Lua SDK: R.revive.tokens/add_token (experimental) — add party revive tokens during a run
highlights: Lua SDK: R.revive.tokens/add_token (experimental) — add party revive tokens during a run

entries.summary: New SDK APIs: R.melody.choose/remove by name (the old GUID-based choose never worked), R.control.lock/unlock/release, R.run.next_chapter/win/lose (current chapter only).
highlights: Mods can start collecting a melody by name, or remove one (R.melody.choose / remove)
Mods can freeze and release the player's controls (R.control.lock / release)
Mods can finish the chapter, win or lose the run (R.run.next_chapter / win / lose)

entries.summary: New SDK APIs: R.talent.reset / upgrade_random / upgrade_lowest / upgrade / add_random_ultimate change talents during a run; R.status.clear / clear_stagger cleanse the hero.
highlights: Mods can upgrade talents: random, lowest, a specific one, or straight to legendary (R.talent.upgrade*)
Mods can add a random ultimate talent or reset every talent (R.talent.add_random_ultimate / reset)
Mods can clear status effects and stagger (R.status.clear)

entries.summary: New SDK APIs: R.give.remove_random, R.give.remove_all and R.give.duplicate_random take items away or copy one, by rarity or for any.
highlights: Mods can remove a random item, or every item, of a rarity (R.give.remove_random / remove_all)
Mods can give a second copy of a random common, rare or epic item (R.give.duplicate_random)

entries.summary: New SDK APIs: R.ability (reset/reduce cooldowns, add/remove charges), R.shards.gain (shards as a pickup, gain bonuses apply), R.ingredient (add/remove keys and other ingredients), R.xp.set_level / set_xp.
highlights: Mods can reset or shorten ability cooldowns and add charges (R.ability)
Mods can give dream shards as a pickup, so shard-gain bonuses apply (R.shards.gain)
Mods can give or take keys and other ingredients (R.ingredient)
Mods can set the party level directly (R.xp.set_level)

entries.summary: Bug reports are easier to act on: the shared log now includes the health check and your loader version, and can be copied instead of uploaded.
highlights: Share log: the report now lists any problems the health check found and which loader you have installed, so whoever helps you sees the likely cause first.
Share log: "Copy report" puts the same redacted report on your clipboard if you would rather not upload it.
Mod authors: rsmm lint now catches Lua that reads a variable above the line that declares it (it is always nil in game), and POI components that would load but show no icon or prompt.
Mod authors: an item whose base is not a shipped item is now an error with a suggestion, instead of silently making nothing.

entries.summary: Fix: no online / no party code on Windows while the loader is installed (the 5.9.11 fix was incomplete)
highlights: Fix: no online / no party code on Windows while the loader is installed (the 5.9.11 fix was incomplete)

entries.summary: Online works again on Windows with RSMM, mods from the hub no longer stop the game from launching, and the Log screen can open and clear its logs.
highlights: Fixed: on Windows, launching through RSMM could leave you offline with no party code, even with no mods enabled. The game now uses Windows' own networking library while modded.
Fixed: "rsmm apply failed" (IndexError) on launch after installing No Overtime Tint, or another mod that edits game entities, from the hub.
Log screen: "Open folder" shows every saved run, and "Delete logs" clears them.
Shared logs and crash reports now show your real RSMM version instead of 0.0.0-dev.
Talent builder: "Hits apply a status" makes one of a hero's hits Chill, Ignite, Bleed, Weaken, make Vulnerable or Root while you own the talent (not yet tested in game).

entries.summary: Fix: online / party code failing on Windows while the loader is installed
highlights: Fix: online / party code failing on Windows while the loader is installed

entries.summary: Build your own talents in the editor: a new step-by-step builder, abilities that grow bigger, and effects borrowed from other heroes.
highlights: Editor: a new custom-talent builder. Pick the talent to replace, name it, and add building blocks or start from an example. Ideas it can't build yet ("POWER spawns a tornado") can be sent to us from the same screen.
Talent builder: "Make an ability bigger" grows an ability's area, length or width while you own the talent. Tested in game: Melusine's POWER area.
Talent builder: borrow a talent's effect from another hero (9 talents can move, e.g. Sun Wukong's Focused Strikes on Piper's Virtuoso). Its numbers follow your card's rarity.
Talent builder: bonuses that last until "your next ATTACK" and bonuses that can trigger "at most once every N seconds".
Editor: reopening a mod keeps your custom talents editable, and the editor says when it can't find the game.
For mod makers: rsmm diff shows what applying one mod changes, rsmm watch checks a mod before applying it, and mistyped mod names and commands get a suggestion.
Fixed: profile, install, sign-in and background-helper bugs in the app, and several security gaps.

entries.summary: Per-ability crit chance and cooldown reduction stats now read the right ability
highlights: Fixed: mods reading or changing one ability's crit chance or cooldown reduction got a different ability's stat
